Reason: The chest X-rays (PA and lateral) show two distinct nodules indicated by arrows: one in the right middle lobe obscuring the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, combined with the mention of a mosaic attenuation pattern (often seen on CT in this context), is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
